program.description: Program file under test (.st, .fbd, .ld or .sfc), relative to this YAML file.

scan_ms.description: Virtual scan-cycle period in milliseconds. Every scan advances virtual time by this much.

scenarios.description: Independent scenarios; each one starts from a freshly initialized VM.

name.description: Scenario name, shown in reports and in the Testing view.

given.description: Variables seeded before the first scan. Values are coerced to the declared variable types (e.g. `40` into a REAL becomes 40.0).

steps.description: Ordered steps. Every step needs `set`, `advance`, or both.

expect.description: Final checks, evaluated after the last step.

set.description: Variable writes applied before this step's scans (same coercion as `given`). A set-only step runs no scan.

advance.description: Virtual time to run: `25scans` (exact scan count), `500ms` or `2s` (floor(ms / scan_ms) scans).

expect.description: Checks evaluated right after this step's scans.

expectations.description: Variable name → matcher. `true`/`false` for BOOL, an integer for exact numeric equality, a float for a 1e-4 window, a string for STRING/enum, or `{approx, tol}`.
